text:
Lena M.: Proposal: run a tight 3-email 'API Teaser Sprint' to convert inbound docs downloaders into demos or API trials. Goal = demo bookings (primary) + trial starts (secondary). Window = 10 days post-download.

Gabe R.: 👍 good. segment by intent inferred from doc pages visited: eval (benchmarks), infra (deployment), ml (examples). Tailor hero line only.

Priya S.: Subject line candidates (A/B):
- A: 'See Redwood inference in 10 minutes'
- B: 'How teams cut token costs with smart serving'
We'll A/B test per segment.

Lena M.: cadence draft:
T+0: thank-you + 1-click demo scheduler + quick how-to (day 0)
T+3: developer quick-win + short snippet + demo CTA (day 3)
T+10: last-chance + small incentive (15-min consult) + trial CTA (day 10)
Send window: 9-11am recipient local time, roll sends over 48h.

Gabe R.: tiny creative asks: swap hero sentence per segment: eval -> 'benchmarked and verified', infra -> 'predictable latency at scale', ml -> 'maximize quality per token'. rest of the copy identical.

Priya S.: add micro-survey link in email 2 for ml segment: 1 question 'primary blocker' with radio choices. keep it 1-click.

Diego M.: tracking & routing notes: UTM = utm_source=api_teaser&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=teaser_2976&utm_content={segment}_{variant}. If they book demo or start trial, set contact prop `converted_teaser=true` -> suppress remaining sends. Also suppress on `do_not_contact=true`.

Maya (mail-bot): draft campaign saved: api-teaser-2976 (draft). I'll append utm_content automatically when links are built. Also will add `List-Unsubscribe` header.

Gabe R.: sample sizes: estimated inbound docs = 1580 last 30d. splits now: eval=360, infra=420, ml=300, unknown=500. we'll cap unknown at 30% to reduce noise.

Priya S.: A/B splits: for medium segments use 50/50, for smaller use 60/40. But Lena wants quick winner; propose 35/65 across board to bias discovery.

Lena M.: pick 35/65 — want a fast lift signal.

Diego M.: deliverability: throttle 3500/hr, seeds across providers 20 addresses, preflight 12h before send. If seed inboxing <85% pause. Also check DKIM/SPF/DMARC.

Maya (mail-bot): preflight check scheduled 12h pre-launch. I will post spam score and seed results here.

Gabe R.: creative snippet for email 1 (single-line code):
`curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -d '{"input":"Hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`
Use monospace inline.

Priya S.: small experiment: for 15% of infra segment swap the CTA to 'See Dedicated performance' vs 'Book demo' to test product messaging. Track separately.

Diego M.: ok allocate 15% infra cell. Map variant to `teaser_variant` property.

Lena M.: webinar follow-up ask: if someone registers for the webinar from any email, we should mark `webinar_registrant=true` and suppress the last promo; they get a different nurture.

Maya (mail-bot): implemented: `suppress_on` accepts `converted_teaser,webinar_registrant,do_not_contact`. Will suppress immediately on webhook.

Gabe R.: put alt-text for hero images, ensure plain-text fallback. Also confirm images render in Gmail/Outlook seeds.

Priya S.: assets needed: 3 subject lines pairs, 3 body templates, hero images per segment, code snippet, micro-survey link, alt-text. I'll upload assets by 4pm PT.

Diego M.: timeline: segments published by EOD, preflight 12h before, launch next Tue 9am PT. We'll review 24h and 72h metrics and iterate.

Lena M.: thanks team. Maya, once preflight passes drop results here and I'll approve send. :rocket:
